reviews.title: Corsair = great products
reviews.comment: my older pc along with the main large plug has another motherboard 4 pin plug I thought this unit was not compatible but talked to a PC builder and he showed me the power supply has an 8 pin plug that also works on the the 4 pin connection. The plastic housing has a specific shape so you can only put it on one way the correct way.  If you have an older motherboard like me this info might help.  The only thing this power supply was missing is a small plug for my optical drive but I guess a lot of computers do not have optical drives now days or maybe the plug style has changed.
